extra.text: The chromaticity coordinates of the mass-produced retro-reflective device shall comply with UN R150.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of production samples per R150; pass if the coordinates lie within the prescribed red colour boundaries.

extra.text: For testing the retro-reflection, the retro-reflector shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
extra.test_case: Verify the source calibration certificate confirms CIE Illuminant A (2856 K).

extra.text: If the retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C as the heat resistance test procedure.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 1 para. 1: condition the retro-reflector sample in a dry-atmosphere oven at 65 °C ± 2 °C for 48 consecutive hours; record temperature and duration.

extra.text: After the resistance to heat test, no appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection after Annex 6 Part 1 heat test and cooling; pass if no appreciable distortion of the device or its optical component is visible.

extra.text: The retro-reflector, being part of a lamp, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para. 1.1: remove removable parts, immerse 10 min in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C, top of illuminating surface 20 mm below water surface.

extra.text: The water immersion test of the retro-reflector shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para. 1.1: repeat 10 min immersion at 50 °C ± 5 °C with device inverted, rear face under about 20 mm of water.

extra.text: After the 50 °C immersions, the retro-reflector sample units shall be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para. 1.1: immediately transfer to water at 25 °C ± 5 °C under the same immersion conditions (both orientations, 10 min).

extra.text: If the retro-reflector is of Class IB or IIIB, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture test and the dust test of Annex 6 Part 3 shall be applied as an alternative test procedure of resistance to water penetration.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 paras 2 and 2.3: perform both the moisture (water spray) test and the dust exposure test on the sample device; record the manufacturer's request for the alternative procedure.

extra.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.4: verify a test duration of 12 h with 12 complete 5/55 min cycles.

extra.text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be formed in the interior of the device, nor shall one be able to form by tapping or tilting the device.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.6: visually inspect the interior for moisture accumulation, then tap and tilt the device; pass if no standing pool of water is present or formed.

extra.text: Since the retro-reflector is combined with a lamp, the rear combination lamp shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
extra.test_case: Remove all removable parts; expose to saline mist 24 h, dry 2 h, expose 24 h (total 50 h); sample must complete test cycle for subsequent evaluation.

extra.text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9.
extra.test_case: After corrosion test and 48 h recovery, clean salt deposits, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≥ Table 9 value.

extra.text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not more than the value in Table 10.
extra.test_case: After corrosion test and 48 h recovery, clean salt deposits, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≤ Table 10 value.

extra.text: In case of retro-reflective devices, the samples shall be exposed to accelerated artificial weathering for a period of 500 hours.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 6 para. 3.1: expose retro-reflector samples for 500 h per EN ISO 4892-2:2013 and Table A6-1; verify exposure duration of 500 h logged.

extra.text: When test method TM2 (Black-Panel thermometer, cycle No. 4 of EN ISO 4892-2:2013) is used, the exposure cycle shall be 102 min dry and 18 min water spray, with broadband irradiance (300 to 400 nm) of 60 ± 2 W/m², narrowband irradiance (340 nm) of 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m², black-panel temperature of 63 ± 3 °C and relative humidity of 50 ± 10 %.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 6 Table A6-1 TM2: verify chamber settings and logs show 102 min dry / 18 min spray cycles, 60 ± 2 W/m² (300-400 nm), 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² (340 nm), BPT 63 ± 3 °C, RH 50 ± 10 %.

extra.text: About five minutes after wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually and must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
extra.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1 para. 1.1(b): visual inspection about 5 min after the fuel wipe. Pass: no apparent surface changes; slight surface cracks are acceptable.

extra.text: The approval mark of the retro-reflective device shall be arranged in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation; the arrangements shown in Annex 10 (Figures A10-I and A10-II) are examples only.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the marking on the lamp and of the marking drawing against paragraph 3.3. and the Annex 10 examples; pass if all elements required by paragraph 3.3. are present and arranged accordingly.

extra.text: The approval number of the retro-reflective device shall be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval mark on the device; pass if the approval number is located adjacent to the circle surrounding the letter "E".

extra.text: The digits constituting the approval number of the retro-reflective device shall face the same way as the "E".
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval mark; pass if the approval number digits have the same orientation as the letter "E".

extra.text: The group of symbols indicating the class of the retro-reflective device shall be diametrically opposite the approval number.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval mark; pass if the class symbol is positioned diametrically opposite the approval number relative to the circle surrounding the "E".

extra.text: Where the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector form part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the approval marking shall be arranged as a common marking for the unit, as in the variants of Models D and E of Figure A10-II, or another arrangement in accordance with paragraph 3.3.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the marking on the combination lamp against Figure A10-II Models D/E and paragraph 3.3.; pass if the identifiers of all functions in the unit are shown in a compliant arrangement.

extra.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps of the rear combination lamp to be inadvertently maladjusted.
extra.test_case: Design review and physical inspection of the mounting: verify positive locating features (pins/clips/fixed fasteners) define a unique installed position and orientation with no free adjustment; apply handling loads and vibration and confirm no change in aim/orientation; pass if lamp cannot be shifted out of its prescribed position without deliberate tool use.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and retro-reflectors on the left- and right-hand side) shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this estimate is to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.
extra.test_case: Measure the installed positions of the left and right units on the vehicle against the median longitudinal plane using the exterior geometrical form of the lamps; pass if the positions are symmetrical.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
extra.test_case: Compare the external geometry of the left-hand and mirrored right-hand units (drawings/CAD and physical samples); pass if the units are mirror-symmetrical externally, interior structure excluded.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair (left and right rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and retro-reflectors) shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
extra.test_case: Measure the colour of emitted/reflected light of each function on left and right units per the applicable colorimetric method; pass if both units meet the same colorimetric requirements for each function.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function.
extra.test_case: Perform photometric measurements of each function on left and right units at the prescribed test points; pass if the intensity distributions are substantially identical (unless approved as a matched pair).

extra.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the installation requirements for the paired rear combination lamps (rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflectors) set out in the preceding paragraphs shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
extra.test_case: Inspect the vehicle drawings and the installed vehicle. Measure the lamp positions relative to the median longitudinal plane, and compare their mounting heights, colours and photometric characteristics. Pass if any deviation from the paired-lamp requirements is limited to what the vehicle's asymmetrical external shape makes unavoidable.

extra.text: The colorimetric requirements of each lamp function (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp) shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of each function individually with all other functions switched OFF. Pass: chromaticity coordinates within the prescribed colour limits (red for rear position and stop, white for reversing).

extra.text: If the lamp is a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d), it shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.; two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces included in the same lamp body and/or having a common outer lens shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.
extra.test_case: Review of lamp classification and geometric evaluation per paragraph 5.7.2.1. (60 % area or 75 mm gap criterion). Pass: criterion met and the lamp is not declared/approved as an interdependent lamp system on the basis of separate surfaces in a common housing/outer lens.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the stop lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
extra.test_case: With the stop lamp continuously activated, record intensity, colour and lit apparent surface over time. Pass if they stay steady with no intentional variation. Emergency stop signal flashing is only permitted where specifically allowed by paragraph 6.23 of UN R48.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the reversing lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
extra.test_case: With the reversing lamp switched ON, monitor intensity, chromaticity (white) and apparent surface over time. Pass if there is no intentional variation, such as flashing, dimming or a sequential pattern.

extra.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of the vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp of the rear combination lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
extra.test_case: Geometric or visual check on the vehicle per Annex 4: observer moved throughout Zone 1 in the transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle. Pass if no part of the apparent surface of any red function is directly visible.

extra.text: If the rear position lamp or stop lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources of the interdependent lamp system shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
extra.test_case: Functional check of the interdependent lamp system: activate and deactivate the function and observe all LED light sources of all interdependent lamps. Pass: all light sources switch ON and OFF simultaneously with no independent operation.

extra.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
extra.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates (x,y) of the rear position lamp light with the lamp operating at its rated voltage/current; pass if the coordinates lie within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation's colour definitions.

extra.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
extra.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates (x,y) of the stop lamp light with the lamp operating at its rated voltage/current; pass if the coordinates lie within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation's colour definitions.

extra.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
extra.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates (x,y) of the reversing lamp light; pass if within the white area bounded by y = 0.150 + 0.640 x, y = 0.440, x = 0.500, y = 0.382, y = 0.050 + 0.750 x and x = 0.310.

extra.text: The colour of the light reflected by the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
extra.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the retro-reflected light under the standard illuminant according to the retro-reflector colour test procedure; pass if the coordinates lie within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation's colour definitions.

extra.text: The number of rear position lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count rear position lamps fitted and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specification for rear position lamps (para. 6.10.2); pass if equal.

extra.text: The number of stop lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count stop lamps fitted and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specification for stop lamps (para. 6.7.2); pass if equal.

extra.text: The number of reversing lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count reversing lamps fitted and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specification for reversing lamps (para. 6.4.2); pass if equal.

extra.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count rear non-triangular retro-reflectors fitted and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specification for rear retro-reflectors (para. 6.14.2); pass if equal.

extra.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use" (fixed position meaning the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not).
extra.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed rest position (locked or not) other than the normal position of use; determine the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis that remains unobscured. Pass: no more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface hidden.

extra.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the retro-reflector shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use" (fixed position meaning the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not).
extra.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed rest position other than the normal position of use; determine the unobscured apparent surface of the retro-reflector in the direction of the reference axis. Pass: no more than 50 per cent hidden.

extra.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable for the rear position lamp, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
extra.test_case: Move the movable component to each fixed position where more than 50 per cent of the rear position lamp apparent surface is hidden; verify the additional lamps switch ON automatically and verify by inspection/measurement that they meet the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps. Pass: additional lamps ON and compliant.

extra.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable for the rear position lamp and additional lamps are not provided, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements; this alternative does not apply to retro-reflectors (paragraph 5.21.3).
extra.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for the presence of the user notice describing the positions of movable components in which more than 50 per cent of the rear position lamp apparent surface is hidden and the need to warn other road users. Pass: notice present; verify retro-reflector compliance is achieved by paragraph 5.21 or 5.21.1 and not by this notice.

extra.text: The rear position lamp, even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; the rear position lamp shall therefore be operable by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
extra.test_case: Inspect the lamp as installed on the M1 vehicle: with only the light source and/or fuse fitted (no additional wiring, modules or modifications), switch on the rear position lamp function; pass if the lamp operates.

extra.text: The stop lamp, even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; the stop lamp shall therefore be operable by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
extra.test_case: Inspect the lamp as installed on the M1 vehicle: with only the light source and/or fuse fitted, apply the service brake; pass if the stop lamp operates without any further installation work.

extra.text: The reversing lamp, even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; the reversing lamp shall therefore be operable by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
extra.test_case: Inspect the lamp as installed on the M1 vehicle: with only the light source and/or fuse fitted, engage reverse gear with the ignition on; pass if the reversing lamp operates without any further installation work.

extra.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in colour to the function that has ceased to operate.
extra.test_case: Simulate failure of rear position lamp; verify replacement function emits red light within the rear position lamp colour boundaries (R48 / R148 colorimetric requirements). Pass: colour similar (red).

extra.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in main intensity to the function that has ceased to operate.
extra.test_case: Simulate failure of rear position lamp; photometric measurement of replacement function at H-V and key points. Pass: main intensity similar to the original rear position lamp values.

extra.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in position to the function that has ceased to operate.
extra.test_case: Simulate failure; inspect/measure position of the replacement light-emitting surface on the vehicle. Pass: position similar to the original rear position lamp (installation dimensions per R48).

extra.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
extra.test_case: With replacement active, actuate the replacement device's original function (e.g. braking). Pass: original function operates and meets its photometric requirements.

extra.text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
extra.test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure with replacement active. Pass: dashboard tell-tale illuminates indicating temporary replacement and need for repair.

extra.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 have variable luminous intensity control, they shall respond simultaneously only to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2.
extra.test_case: Review the control strategy and inputs, then trigger each listed environmental and traffic condition. Pass if both lamps respond simultaneously and only to the conditions in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2.

extra.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control are combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, their intensities shall all vary together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
extra.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity of both functions at several control levels across the full range. Pass if both vary together in the same direction and in a similar proportion.

extra.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 have variable luminous intensity control, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of the two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained in the entire intensity range, including throughout variation transitions.
extra.test_case: Measure the intensities of both lamps simultaneously, at the same measurement point, at steady levels and during transitions across the whole range. Pass if the prescribed stop/position intensity ratio is met at every point.

extra.text: When the luminous intensity of the variable-intensity rear position lamp or stop lamp is increased or decreased in relation to ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds or contamination of the light emitting surface, the intensity shall remain within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations.
extra.test_case: Simulate each environmental condition and measure photometry at the minimum and maximum adapted levels. Pass if all values stay within the minimum and maximum limits of the pertinent device regulation (e.g. UN R7 / R148).

extra.text: A decrease of the luminous intensity of the variable-intensity rear position lamp or stop lamp due to traffic conditions shall only be activated when the vehicle speed is equal to or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal to or less than 20 m.
extra.test_case: Run a vehicle or HIL test that varies speed and following distance. Pass if dimming activates only at speed ≤ 20 km/h or following distance ≤ 20 m.

extra.text: An activated traffic-condition decrease of the luminous intensity of the rear position lamp or stop lamp shall not remain active once the vehicle speed exceeds 50 km/h, unless the activation conditions of paragraph 5.26.2. (speed ≤ 20 km/h or distance to following vehicle ≤ 20 m) are again fulfilled.
extra.test_case: Activate dimming, then accelerate above 50 km/h with the following distance > 20 m. Pass if the intensity returns to the non-reduced level.

extra.text: A decrease of the luminous intensity of the rear position lamp or stop lamp due to traffic conditions shall remain within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations.
extra.test_case: Measure photometry in the reduced-intensity state. Pass if the values are not below the minimum limits of the pertinent device regulation.

extra.text: No sharp variation of intensity of the variable-intensity rear position lamp or stop lamp shall be observed during transition.
extra.test_case: Record intensity over time with a photodetector during each up and down transition, together with visual observation. Pass if there are no abrupt steps or flicker and the change is gradual.

extra.text: When the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, and if the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop or reversing function) has, according to its type approval documentation, been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the lamp shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant device or function as it has been approved. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
extra.test_case: On the vehicle in constant voltage operating condition as specified by the applicant, measure the voltage at the lamp terminals for each function; pass if the voltage does not exceed the voltage stated in the lamp's type approval documentation.

extra.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., for 6 Volt-Systems, the voltage at the terminals of the rear position, stop and reversing lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V by more than 3 per cent, when the vehicle electrical system is in a constant voltage operating condition. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
extra.test_case: Measure terminal voltage of each function on the vehicle in constant voltage operating condition; pass if ≤ 6.75 V + 3 per cent.

extra.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., for 12 Volt-Systems, the voltage at the terminals of the rear position, stop and reversing lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 13.5 V by more than 3 per cent, when the vehicle electrical system is in a constant voltage operating condition. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
extra.test_case: Measure terminal voltage of each function on the vehicle in constant voltage operating condition; pass if ≤ 13.5 V + 3 per cent.

extra.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., for 24 Volt-Systems, the voltage at the terminals of the rear position, stop and reversing lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 28 V by more than 3 per cent, when the vehicle electrical system is in a constant voltage operating condition. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
extra.test_case: Measure terminal voltage of each function on the vehicle in constant voltage operating condition; pass if ≤ 28 V + 3 per cent.

extra.text: When the rear combination lamp is installed on the vehicle, there shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility of the stop lamp to the propagation of light from any part of its apparent surface observed from infinity; obstacles already present when the lamp was type-approved are not taken into account.
extra.test_case: Installed-vehicle inspection over the stop lamp geometric visibility angles; pass if no obstruction of any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles present at lamp type approval.

extra.text: When the rear combination lamp is installed on the vehicle, there shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility of the reversing lamp to the propagation of light from any part of its apparent surface observed from infinity; obstacles already present when the lamp was type-approved are not taken into account.
extra.test_case: Installed-vehicle inspection over the reversing lamp geometric visibility angles; pass if no obstruction of any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles present at lamp type approval.

extra.text: When the rear combination lamp is installed on the vehicle, there shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility of the retro-reflector to the propagation of light from any part of its apparent surface observed from infinity; obstacles already present when the device was type-approved are not taken into account.
extra.test_case: Installed-vehicle inspection over the rear retro-reflector geometric visibility angles; pass if no obstruction of any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles present at type approval.

extra.text: If, when the rear combination lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of a lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
extra.test_case: Photometric measurement of the installed (partially masked) unit or with representative masking; pass if the unmasked part meets all photometric values prescribed for approval of each function.

extra.text: If an LED module of the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop or reversing function) is not replaceable, this shall be stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval; otherwise the LED module shall be replaceable.
extra.test_case: Document and design review: compare the replaceability of each LED module in the lamp (removal without destroying the lamp) against the component type approval communication sheet (UN R7/R23 or R148). Pass if each non-replaceable LED module is declared non-replaceable on the communication sheet, or if the module is replaceable.

extra.text: When installed on a vehicle, the rear position lamp function shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Document check: verify a valid device type approval (UN R148 approval mark for rear position lamp, category R/R1/R2) is held and marked on the lamp before vehicle installation; pass if approval exists and matches the installed device.

extra.text: When installed on a vehicle, the stop lamp function shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Document check: verify a valid device type approval (UN R148 approval mark for stop lamp, category S1/S2) is held and marked on the lamp; pass if approval exists and matches the installed device.

extra.text: When installed on a vehicle, the reversing lamp function shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Document check: verify a valid device type approval (UN R148 approval mark for reversing lamp, AR) is held and marked on the lamp; pass if approval exists and matches the installed device.

extra.text: When installed on a vehicle, the rear retro-reflector shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Document check: verify a valid device type approval (UN R150 approval mark for rear retro-reflector, class IA or IB) is held and marked on the device; pass if approval exists and matches the installed device.

extra.text: If the light-signalling lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
extra.test_case: Design review for presence of a manufacturer logo in the light-emitting surface; if present, verify the UN R148 approval covers the logo configuration; pass if approval to UN R148 including the logo exists.

extra.text: A reversing lamp shall be mandatorily installed on motor vehicles (including category M1).
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify that at least one reversing lamp function is fitted; pass if present.

extra.text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device is optional.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count reversing lamp devices; pass if 1 or 2 devices are fitted.

extra.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
extra.test_case: Measure height of the illuminating surface above ground on unladen vehicle per R48 procedures; pass if lowest point ≥ 250 mm and highest point ≤ 1,200 mm.

extra.text: For reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle α shall be 15° upwards and 5° downwards, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7: verify unobstructed apparent surface from 15° up to 5° down relative to reference axis; pass if visible throughout.

extra.text: If there are two reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle β shall be 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7 for each of the two lamps: verify visibility over 45° outwards and 30° inwards; pass if visible throughout.

extra.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify reference axis of the reversing lamp is directed rearwards.

extra.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
extra.test_case: Check R23/R148 requirements for failure indication; if required, simulate lamp failure and verify tell-tale operates.

extra.text: Stop lamp devices of category S1 or S2 shall be installed on the M1 category vehicle (mandatory).
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted on the M1 vehicle. Pass if present.

extra.text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be installed on the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the S1/S2 stop lamps, handed unit plus mirrored opposite-side unit. Pass if exactly two are installed.

extra.text: For M1 category vehicles, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of an S1 or S2 category stop lamp which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Measure on the vehicle, according to R48 para. 5.8 methods, the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle. Pass if ≤ 400 mm on each side.

extra.text: The horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of the S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be below the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface of the S3 or S4 category device.
extra.test_case: On the vehicle, measure the height of the upper edge of the S1/S2 apparent surface and the height of the lower edge of the S3/S4 apparent surface. Pass if the S3/S4 lower edge is higher.

extra.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the vehicle installation. Pass if the lamp is mounted at the vehicle rear.

extra.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed 15° up and 15° down, or 5° down where the mounting height is < 750 mm.

extra.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Inspect the reference axis direction on the vehicle. Pass if it points rearward.

extra.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamp shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
extra.test_case: Check the component regulation (R7/R148) requirements. If a failure tell-tale is required, simulate an LED failure and verify the tell-tale activates.

extra.text: Rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatorily installed on the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that the rear combination lamp contains a rear position lamp function approved as category R, R1 or R2 (approval marking check). Pass if present on the vehicle.

extra.text: Two rear position lamps shall be installed on the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the rear position lamps fitted (left-hand unit and mirrored right-hand unit). Pass if exactly two mandatory rear position lamps are installed.

extra.text: The rear position lamps shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
extra.test_case: Document and marking check: verify the approval mark on the lamp references UN R7 02 or later series, or UN R148 00 or later series. Pass if a valid approval exists.

extra.text: In length, the rear position lamps shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the rear combination lamp with the rear position lamp is mounted at the rear of the vehicle. Pass if located at the vehicle rear.

extra.text: For M1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall cover a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
extra.test_case: If the alternative is chosen, verify that a rear side-marker lamp is installed and that the apparent surface is visible over 45° outwards to 45° inwards (20° inwards under H plane if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if both conditions are met.

extra.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the reference axis of the rear position lamp points rearwards as installed. Pass if oriented rearwards.

extra.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify a non-triangular rear retro-reflector is fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

extra.text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
extra.test_case: Check the approval marking and certificate of the retro-reflector: pass if Class IA or IB per UN R3 02+ series or UN R150 00+ series.

extra.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
extra.test_case: Visual and photometric assessment on the vehicle: pass if any additional retro-reflecting device or material does not impair the mandatory rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions.

extra.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
extra.test_case: Measure on the vehicle (unladen, ground substantially horizontal) the height of the lowest point of the illuminating surface above ground; pass if ≥ 250 mm.

extra.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not more than 900 mm above the ground, or not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), or 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively.
extra.test_case: Measure height of the highest point of the illuminating surface above ground; pass if ≤ 1,200 mm (grouped with rear lamps in the combination lamp), or ≤ 1,500 mm with bodywork-shape justification.

extra.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be situated at the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

extra.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the retro-reflector reference axis points rearwards; pass if rearward facing.

extra.text: Red light from the rear position lamp and stop lamp functions shall not be directly visible to the eye of an observer moving within zone 1, in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see paragraph 5.10.4.). Zone 1 is bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
extra.test_case: Visibility check per Annex 4 with the lamp installed on the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground. Explore zone 1 in front of the vehicle between eye heights of 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground. Pass if no red light from the lamp, including its illuminated surface or reflections, is directly visible from any point in the zone.

extra.text: For verifying that red light is not visible to the front, zone 1 shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes. Each plane forms an angle of 15° outwards to the front from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane. Each plane passes through the point of contact of the vertical planes parallel to the median longitudinal plane that delimit the vehicle's overall width. If there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane.
extra.test_case: Geometric or CAD sightline analysis per Annex 4. Construct 15° outward vertical planes through the foremost overall-width contact points and, from the zone 1 envelope (1 m to 2.2 m height) bounded by these planes, check sightlines to the lamp's red light-emitting surfaces. Pass if no red light-emitting surface is directly visible.

extra.text: The values measured for the distances of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
extra.test_case: Compare measured mounting distances against the individual installation specifications for each lamp function; pass if all limits are met.

extra.text: The angles of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation, and the values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
extra.test_case: Measure angles of geometric visibility per paragraph 2.10.7. on the vehicle; pass if the individual angle specifications for each lamp are met within an allowance of ±3º.

extra.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp and their associated tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
extra.test_case: Functional check of switching conditions and tell-tales against paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. and individual lamp specifications; pass if all conform.

extra.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings, and shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of installed lamps and markings; pass if presence, number, colour (red for rear position/stop/retro-reflector, white for reversing), arrangement and category comply with paragraphs 5.15., 5.16. and individual specifications.
